description: Renovate replaces Dependabot here. Dependabot cannot see these versions at all: appVersion is not a dependency manifest entry, and its docker ecosystem does not parse the repository/tag split used in Helm values.

customManagers.description: Chart.yaml appVersion, tracked against n8nio/n8n. Note appVersion is also used as the tag for n8nio/runners, so if a release ever lands on n8nio/n8n before n8nio/runners, the task-runner sidecar will fail to pull until runners catches up.

sandboxService.image.version — one pinned version shared by all three n8n-sandbox-service-* images, which upstream releases together. Anchored to the repository line above it: a bare `version:` matcher would claim any other semver `version:` key added to values.yaml later.

packageRules.description: n8n itself, via the Chart.yaml appVersion custom manager. Patch and minor releases automerge; major waits for review. CI verifies n8nio/runners has published the same tag before the PR can merge, since appVersion is the tag for both images. The commit type carries the intended chart bump: an n8n minor is a chart feat/minor, an n8n patch a chart fix/patch.
An n8n minor release is the one update that warrants a feat commit, and so a chart minor.
Sandbox service. Preview upstream, so hold every update for review. chore: it does not cut a chart release on its own; it rides along in the next n8n release.
Base images for the init and wait containers. Low risk, so automerge minor and patch. chore: these do not cut a chart release on their own either.
GitHub Actions, grouped so they land as one PR. Never chart-affecting, so always chore.
Never touch the image tags in values.yaml that are intentionally empty so they inherit Chart.yaml appVersion. Scoped to helm-values so it cannot disable the appVersion custom manager.
